How it works: the first time you click Backup Now, the browser’s folder picker opens. Select a folder once — the backup file (for example B2B-Backup-2026-10-28_14-46-30.json) is saved directly in that folder, and later manual and auto backups use the same folder. To use a different folder, click Select / Change Folder and pick a new one.

Notes: folder backup works in Chrome or Edge on a computer. If the browser asks permission to save files in the folder, allow it. After a page refresh the browser may ask once to confirm folder access — click Backup Now to allow it again, then auto backup resumes. Later, press Restore to bring back Inbox, Orders, Payments, Events, People and Signal state from a backup file.

Page filter: All Pages — Check Chats and the error list show every Page.

This agent never sends a message to a customer. Only the reply agent replies to customers. The Conversation Agent watches the live chats, finds wrong replies, and shows the correct reply beside each one. When you press Approve, two things happen: that correction becomes a rule for the reply agent, and the reply agent sends that one customer a soft recovery message that fixes the wrong reply — the missing photo, the correct price / model, or the order resumed from where it got stuck. Only one recovery message is ever sent per error: if the customer does not reply, there is no repeated chasing.
What it checksModel forgotten after the customer named it • Wrong price vs the Page price list • Photo asked but not sent • Same document asked again after it was received (document loop) • A question asked mid-order left unanswered • Model words used as the customer's name.

Self-Test — Order Journey Checks TEST MODE ONLY No self-test run yet
TEST mode only — fake test customers. The agent itself plays a customer and chats with the chat system step by step, up to Order Confirmation. No message ever goes to a real customer, no real payment is ever taken, and no real order is ever created — the payment step uses a TEST number and TEST digits only. A run watches every reply and marks the exact step that gets stuck or goes wrong.
✕ No Signal✕ No live order✕ No notification✕ No payment alert✕ No invoiceTest only — test runs create nothing in Signal Panel, Notifications, Payments, Orders or Invoices. Results stay only in this Self-Test report, fully separated from live data.
The test customer behaves like a real customerShort / incomplete model names • Misspellings • Photo sends (bike photo, NID, own photo, bike-sample photo) • Voice-note turns • Emoji-only turns • Questions mid-order • Address / mobile in mixed formats • “Already given above” • Advance refusal • COD request • Visit request • Price bargaining • Documents sent all together. Each run shows which behaviour was simulated and which step it exposed.

Conversation Stages — How to Talk at Every Stage

The full conversation, stage by stage: what stage the customer is in, what they may say, the exact reply for that stage, what happens next, and what must never be said. The reply always follows the stage — never the other way round. Quoted reply lines are the owner's own lines, in the customer's language; everything else on this page is the guide around them.

Golden Rules — True at Every Stage

ALL PAGES • ALL PATHS
1Stage first, reply secondBefore any reply, check: does an order exist? Are the documents complete? Was a payment number given? Has the owner checked the balance? The answer picks the stage — and the stage picks the reply.
2Answer only what was askedAnswer the customer's exact point first. Never dump price + rules + documents + payment all at once — reveal step by step, one easy question at a time, and keep the conversation going.
3The wait line has one home“Balance check kore janacchi” is said only ONCE, and only after the customer actually reports a payment (last 4 digit / TrxID / screenshot). A question is never answered with the wait line, and the wait line is never repeated.
4Documents gate the bKash numberThe bKash number goes out only after ALL order documents are submitted — never earlier, even if the customer asks for it directly.
5Paid = owner-confirmed onlyA payment is never confirmed by the chat alone. The owner checks his own bKash balance and presses Payment Received — only then is the order confirmed and marked Paid.
6Voice of every replySoft and friendly, always — every “no” included. Address the customer as “sir”, use their name only at attention moments, no emoji, and reply in ONE language only: full Bangla, full English, or Banglish — never mixed, never another language.

Before Any Payment Reply — 4 Checks

PAYMENT STAGES ONLY
  • 1
    Order created? No → the payment cannot be checked at all. Use Stage 0 — the owner's direct question. No wait line, no balance check.
  • 2
    Payment number given by us? No → same Stage 0. Money we never asked for, to a number we never gave, has nothing to match against.
  • 3
    Is the customer asking a question, or reporting a payment? A question (for example “Last number ki abar pathabo”) gets its answer first — Stage 10. Only a real payment report moves to the wait stage.
  • 4
    Has the wait line already been sent for this report? Yes → never send it again. Answer the new message on its own point and wait for the owner's Received / Not Received.
18 STAGES
No stage matches that search — clear the search or pick “All Stages”.

Label After Every Stage Change

ONE LABEL PER CHAT
New customer→ Interested→ Documents Pending→ Documents Complete→ Pending payment→ Paid (owner-confirmed only)→ Order complete→ Delivered

Keep exactly one current-stage label on each chat and update it at every stage change. A warm close or a 24-hour retry carries the Follow-up label instead. The stages above follow this same pipeline — the label and the way of talking always move together.

bKash Personal number for each Page — the number customers are asked to send the advance to

bKash Personal Numbers

6 PAGES
Use the bKash Personal number only. This is not the customer support number — the customer support number must never be used as the bKash number, and it cannot be saved here. When you press Save for a Page, the backend saves that number as text for that Page and uses it in that Page's customer payment messages.

Enter the full 11-digit number starting with 0 (for example 01XXXXXXXXX). The number is saved as text, so the leading zero is kept. Each Page has its own number and its own Save button — changing one Page does not change the others.
